name: Additional Product Action Buttons (APAB)
author: pike136

sections.description:
Additional Product Action Buttons (APAB) allows you to add extra action buttons to WooCommerce product pages without editing theme files.

You can create:
* Redirect buttons (for external links, landing pages, partner offers)
* Contact buttons linked to a form shortcode (for example, WPForms)

The plugin works out of the box with popular WooCommerce themes, including OceanWP and Divi.

Free version behavior

In the free version, contact forms are displayed inline below the button.
This approach ensures maximum compatibility and stability with WooCommerce layouts and form plugins.

Popup modal overlays, advanced design controls, and additional display options will be available in the upcoming PRO version.

Features

  • Add multiple action buttons to a product
  • Redirect buttons open links in a new tab
  • Contact buttons support shortcodes (e.g. WPForms)
  • Inline form display for maximum compatibility
  • Vertical button layout below “Add to cart”
  • Custom CSS class support for styling via theme
  • No theme file modifications required
  • Compatible with OceanWP and Divi themes

Usage

After activation:

  1. Open a product in the WordPress admin.
  2. In the “Additional Product Buttons” meta box:
    • Click “Add button”
    • Enter button text
    • Select button type (Redirect or Popup)
    • Enter a URL or form shortcode
    • Optionally add a custom CSS class
  3. Save the product.

Buttons will appear below the “Add to cart” button on the product page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Edit a WooCommerce product.
  5. Find the meta box “Additional Product Buttons”.
  6. Add one or more buttons and save the product.
sections.faq:
Why does the contact form open below the button instead of a popup?

For stability and compatibility reasons, the free version displays forms inline below the button.
This approach works reliably with all WooCommerce themes and form plugins.

Modal popup overlays will be available in the PRO version.

Which form plugins are supported?

Any form plugin that provides a shortcode can be used.
The plugin has been tested with WPForms (free version).

Can I style the buttons?

Yes. You can assign a custom CSS class to each button and style it using your theme’s Custom CSS or child theme.

Does this plugin work with OceanWP or Divi?

Yes. APAB Free is compatible with OceanWP and Divi.
For Divi users, it is recommended to add custom CSS via Divi → Theme Options → Custom CSS.

Is a PRO version planned?

Yes. The PRO version will include popup modals, advanced design settings, presets, and additional display options.
